svg.aria-label: AgentRQ task board: you add five tasks and five agents, claude, codex, agy, hermes and openclaw, each pick up their own. Cards move from Not Started to Ongoing; codex asks a question and its card turns Blocked until you click Allow; then every card lands in Done and the agents celebrate.
